behavior: Returns a primitive boolean without mutating the input.
Detects accepted ANSI terminal control sequences anywhere in a string.
Rejects ordinary text, literal escape notation, a lone escape, and an escape followed by an ordinary character.
Inputs other than strings are outside the scored contract.
inventory_notes: The package exposes one synchronous pure function and has no CLI, filesystem, TTY, clock, random, native, or external-service behavior.
The production verifier invokes the package through a JSON-safe child-process adapter; candidate code is never imported by the trusted test process.
The dependency is used for ANSI grammar matching and is supplied by the pinned private npm cache closure.
